text.card: A red giant 6,301 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.75 solar masses and 16.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,803 K at its surface.
